csv_scope_of_work: The design services scope of work consists of preparing construction documents for the rehabilitation of the existing arrivals canopy system at the Buffalo Niagara International Airport (BNIA). The work includes developing repair and replacement details for the canopy metal skin system, deteriorated secondary framing, drainage components, and waterproofing systems while maintaining the existing primary structural framework. The project will address water infiltration, corrosion, and deterioration identified in previous condition assessments and will incorporate improvements to drainage and flashing systems to enhance long-term performance and durability.
